_readme: Recursive $refs that tools/sync-ucp-schemas.php could not flatten, per protocol version. GeneratedSchemaValidator resolves only local pointers, so the sync tool inlines every cross-file $ref; a $ref that points back into its own chain cannot be inlined and is replaced with a schema accepting all seven JSON types. That is a subtree which stops being validated, and it is silent, so the count is recorded here and the sync fails if it grows. Raise a budget deliberately and say in the commit message what stopped being validated. Note that the count alone understates the change between these two versions: at 2026-04-08 the single cut is shopping/types/payment_instrument.json's self-reference under $defs/selected_payment_instrument, which nothing $refs, so the placeholder is inert. At 2026-08-25 that cut remains and common/types/constraint_expression.json adds a second one that IS reachable -- it lands on payment_handlers[].available_instruments[].constraints, a real validated path -- so constraint expressions are genuinely unvalidated there. Fixing it needs a validator that handles recursive refs, which is a larger change than flattening.
